semantics.evidence: problem.txt: Moore machine; all sequential logic positive clock edge; positive-edge asynchronous areset resets to walk left
semantics.reset: Asynchronous assertion selects walking left and clears fall duration; no specified power-up state before reset
semantics.walking: ground loss overrides dig, which overrides bump in current direction; both bumps reverse direction
semantics.digging: Persists until ground loss; retains direction and ignores bumps
semantics.falling: Retains direction; ignores bumps and dig; on landing walks if duration <=20, otherwise enters permanent all-zero dead state
semantics.outputs: Moore outputs decoded from state, updated after sequential NBA settling

numeric.fall_duration: Count consecutive complete falling clock intervals: first ground=0 edge enters falling with count 1; after N successive ground=0 sampled edges, landing at next edge completes N falling intervals
numeric.overflow: Saturate count at 21 so arbitrarily long falls remain lethal

verification.oracle: Independent behavioral mode/direction and unbounded integer fall duration based on original text
verification.sampling: Drive inputs on negative edges; inspect stable outputs before positive edge and after NBA settling
cases: both bump directions and simultaneous bumps
verification.timeout: Bounded testbench timeout and fatal on mismatches

specification_ambiguities.resolution: Interpret a falling cycle as the interval between entry into falling and the next positive edge; N ground-low samples followed by landing yield N falling cycles. Text specifies more than 20 cycles, with no waveform.
No initial state specified; verification asserts reset before requiring known outputs.
